request.summary: Create an editorial story spotlight backed by an existing Wallboard feed integration.
request.audience: Visitors and employees reading curated news, updates, or social stories from shared signage.
request.primaryGoal: Rotate through feed entries with strong media and headline hierarchy while preserving usable fallbacks for text-only stories.

assumptions: The customer selects an existing RSS or Wallboard-integrated feed rather than maintaining rows manually.
Feed media is optional and unsafe or broken URLs must fall back without breaking the story layout.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: Feed stories must support full-screen, split-screen, portrait, and compact editorial placements.

settings.purpose: Selects the coordinated Light, Dark, or Custom color scheme.
Message shown when no valid stories exist.
Duration before the next story is featured.
Maximum number of normalized stories retained for rotation.
Places featured media left or right.
Series, category, and progress accent color.

dynamicText.fallback: Clamp after three lines and omit excess headline text only after preserving source, date, and story media.
dynamicText.rationale: Editorial headlines need natural line breaks and more room than operational labels, but must not displace the story rail or frame.

states.expectation: The coordinated dark preset preserves editorial hierarchy and readable story contrast.
Current Wallboard feed items normalize with media, categories, and epoch-second publication dates.
Legacy feed.entries output normalizes enclosure media and HTML-derived snippets.
RSS channel.item output normalizes into the same editorial story model.
An explicit empty state replaces missing feed content.
A failed story image is replaced by the designed media fallback.
Long source, category, headline, and description text remain contained.
A multi-item feed advances to the next featured story on schedule.
A feed refresh updates visible stories without rebuilding the app.

behaviors.expectation: Current Wallboard and legacy RSS wrappers produce the same editorial hierarchy.
The next valid story becomes featured after the configured duration.
Broken or absent feed media uses the designed fallback without a broken image.
Datasource changes update visible story content in place.
An empty datasource still identifies the app and states why the surface is empty, in text legible at the declared viewing distance.

visualDirection.summary: A media-led editorial feature whose composition changes with story imagery instead of imitating an operations dashboard.
signatureChoices: One inspectable story image carries first-viewport weight.
The upcoming-story rail reads as editorial sequencing, not KPI pagination.
avoid: Dark nested cards with equal visual weight.

visualReview.intent: A magazine-like story display with real media weight, disciplined typography, and a restrained upcoming-story rail.
focus: Verify imagery remains legible rather than dark, blurred, or decoratively cropped beyond recognition.
Verify long headlines and text-only stories retain hierarchy without colliding with the rail or frame edges.
